name: Awakened Shrub
languages: one language known by its creator

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While the shrub remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal shrub.

actions.name: Rake
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +1 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 (1d4 − 1) slashing damage. An awakened shrub is an ordinary shrub given sentience and mobility by the awaken spell or similar magic.
